checks: The radius is positive, concave and continuous, and J-P contains zero, so nesting of dilates yields a compact full-dimensional convex body with exactly seven sampled fibers. The centers and volumes follow by the homothety formula.

Enumerated all reflected pairs at p=0,1,2,3 and used reflection for negative p. The exact rational outcomes are 9/16,13/32,5/32,1/32. In particular the (-1,3) pair at p=1 has v_*=1/4 and pays zero. The independent fraction check gives M=11/4 and the gap 7/144.

At Y=(0,P/4), the central three fibers each contain E=(3/4)J+P/4. For a through-Y nonvertical cap the two opposite endpoint traces on E have sum exactly |E| by reflection, and the middle trace has |E|/2. Pure-base cuts pay at least two copies. Hence raw depth is at least 27/32 over all containing caps, even though the particular menu value stays at 9/16.

dependencies.hypotheses: The same-wave theorem applies at every sampled base because each actual fiber is centrally symmetric and the listed opposite bases are disjoint positive-volume reflected pairs. Its formula evaluates the numerical menu, not the actual optimum.

Has a related displaced-mark lower bound for arbitrary equal pairs with ordered collinear centroids, using only the Γ₂ centroid bound. Here the common symmetric subbody gives a separate numerical witness and the exact failure of the stated menu.
